title: Programmatically fetch resource information — fetch
text: utilities provide tools programmatically fetch resource information three types resources: fetch_zenodo_resource retrieves list files found Zenodo record (used BugSigDB, ChocoPhlAn MSigDB). fetch_page_links retrieves list items found online public file directory (used GM, GO, TIGRFAMs WoL). fetch_sparql_output sends query SPARQL endpoint returns response table (used Rhea UniProt).

title: Programmatically fetch resource information — fetch
code: fetch_zenodo_resource(record_id)  fetch_page_links(url)  fetch_sparql_output(query, endpoint, timeout = 1e+06, max_tries = 2L)

title: Programmatically fetch resource information — fetch
text: record_id Character scalar. string specifying Zenodo record id resource fetched. url Character vector. string specifying url href links fetched. query Character scalar. Multi-line string defining SPARQL query sent. endpoint Character scalar. String specifying name endpoint queried. timeout Numeric scalar. Number indicating time limit request SPARQL endpoint. (Default: 1e6) max_tries Numeric scalar. Number indicating maximum number trials request SPARQL endpoint. (Default: 2)

title: Programmatically fetch resource information — fetch
text: fetch_zenodo_resource returns character vector item names found Zenodo record_id. fetch_page_links returns character vector https addresses links found url. fetch_sparql_output returns query response data.frame.

Set url to online directory go_url <- "https://current.geneontology.org/ontology/external2go/"  # Retrieve links to items in directory fetch_page_links(go_url) #>  [1] "http://current.geneontology.org/ontology/index.html"                       #>  [2] "http://current.geneontology.org/ontology/external2go/ec2go"                #>  [3] "http://current.geneontology.org/ontology/external2go/hamap2go"             #>  [4] "http://current.geneontology.org/ontology/external2go/interpro2go"          #>  [5] "http://current.geneontology.org/ontology/external2go/kegg_reaction2go"     #>  [6] "http://current.geneontology.org/ontology/external2go/metacyc2go"           #>  [7] "http://current.geneontology.org/ontology/external2go/pfam2go"              #>  [8] "http://current.geneontology.org/ontology/external2go/pirsf2go"             #>  [9] "http://current.geneontology.org/ontology/external2go/prints2go"            #> [10] "http://current.geneontology.org/ontology/external2go/prosite2go"           #> [11] "http://current.geneontology.org/ontology/external2go/reactome2go"          #> [12] "http://current.geneontology.org/ontology/external2go/resid2go"             #> [13] "http://current.geneontology.org/ontology/external2go/rfam2go"              #> [14] "http://current.geneontology.org/ontology/external2go/rhea2go"              #> [15] "http://current.geneontology.org/ontology/external2go/smart2go"             #> [16] "http://current.geneontology.org/ontology/external2go/um-bbd_enzymeid2go"   #> [17] "http://current.geneontology.org/ontology/external2go/um-bbd_pathwayid2go"  #> [18] "http://current.geneontology.org/ontology/external2go/um-bbd_reactionid2go" #> [19] "http://current.geneontology.org/ontology/external2go/uniprotkb_kw2go"      #> [20] "http://current.geneontology.org/ontology/external2go/uniprotkb_sl2go"      #> [21] "http://current.geneontology.org/ontology/external2go/unirule2go"            # Set SPARQL endpoint uniprot_endpoint <- "https://sparql.uniprot.org/sparql"  # Prepare SPARQL query uniprot_query <- "     PREFIX up: <http://purl.uniprot.org/core/>     SELECT ?taxon     FROM <http://sparql.uniprot.org/taxonomy>     WHERE { ?taxon a up:Taxon. }     LIMIT 6 "  # Send SPARQL query and get response fetch_sparql_output(     query = uniprot_query,     endpoint = uniprot_endpoint ) #>                                       taxon #>                                      <char> #> 1:      http://purl.uniprot.org/taxonomy/10 #> 2:     http://purl.uniprot.org/taxonomy/100 #> 3:    http://purl.uniprot.org/taxonomy/1000 #> 4:   http://purl.uniprot.org/taxonomy/10000 #> 5:  http://purl.uniprot.org/taxonomy/100000 #> 6: http://purl.uniprot.org/taxonomy/1000000
